strings.STAGEFILTER_SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: This mod allows you to filter out certain stages from your runs, with the exception of optional stages and stages required to complete a run.
strings.STAGEFILTER_SETTINGS_EXPANSIONICONS_DESC: Displays the icons of the expansions the stages belong to.
strings.RULE_HEADER_STAGES_SUBTITLE: You can filter out certain stages from your runs.
strings.CHOICE_TOOLTIP_BODY_STAGES_ON: This stage may appear in this run.
strings.CHOICE_TOOLTIP_BODY_STAGES_OFF: This stage is banned from this run.
strings.POPUP_CANNOT_BLOCK_STAGE_DESCRIPTION: You can't ban all stages from the same stage set! Doing so would break the game.
